leadText:
Sergio (Japanese: スギオ Sugio) is a minor character in who appeared in Numero Uno Articuno and The Symbol Life. He is an assistant to Noland at the .

He is Noland's first apprentice, although he jokes around with the Frontier Brain whenever his inventions fail. One of Sergio's duties is caring for the on-site Pokémon. He also refereed the between Noland and .
